release_status: Merge after runtime PR 41928 and a published gateway image containing per-deployment chatgpt_auth_file support. The guide uses the standard gateway quickstart; existing deployments skip installation.
screenshots: Real dashboard at the runtime revision, using fictional account data and an API fixture. No model creation or credentials in screenshots. 1600x1000 captures; rounded frame supplied by article CSS.
verification: Two distinct ChatGPT accounts passed live Chat Completions and Responses through the proxy, including saved prompts. OpenCode Go configuration is checked against provider source and documentation; no live Go subscription request verified.
render: Render launch.html with the litellm-brand-visuals render.mjs script, --brand 2026 --theme light --scale 2.
browser_verification: Desktop, 768px tablet, and 320px/390px phone layouts inspected, including the prompt, login tabs, code blocks, screenshots, and client-settings table. No horizontal page overflow at tested widths; mobile commands wrap and copy/tab controls have at least 44px height. Table stays light under the site dark theme. Collapsed prompt copying previously verified by a real paste; prompt has not been executed by a separate agent.
docker_verification: Official Dockerfile built at the pinned runtime revision. Both ChatGPT accounts returned HTTP 200 and greeting text through Chat Completions and Responses with gateway authentication and writable auth directory mounts.
installation_verification: Quickstart command, default directory, Compose service, and file name checked against the official installer and Compose source. No fresh installation of a published image containing the feature has been verified. Runtime and prior container verification remain pinned to runtime_revision.
